description: This file defines several Pydantic data models related to user notifications in a backend service, including notification data structures, request models for publishing notifications, and response models for listing notifications and subscription status.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Represents a notification for a user, including fields like id, user_id, type, title, message, data, created_at, and read status.

classes.name: PublishNotificationRequest
classes.description: Model for publishing notifications, including optional user_id, type, title, message, and data.

classes.name: NotificationListResponse
classes.description: Response model containing a list of Notification objects, total count, and unread count.

classes.name: SubscriptionResponse
classes.description: Response model indicating subscription status for a user, including user_id and a message.
